programme.title: Resúmenes DAZN LaLiga EA Sports: Betis - Real Sociedad
programme.desc: Resumen con lo más destacado de cada uno de los partidos de Primera División.

programme.title: Resúmenes LALIGA HyperMotion: Córdoba - Girona
programme.desc: El mejor resumen con lo más destacado de cada uno de los partidos de Segunda División. Las mejores jugadas, goles e imágenes de los encuentros que se disputan cada jornada en la competición de plata del fútbol español.

programme.title: World Golf Cup Islas Canarias 2026
programme.desc: Villa, Terry, Hazard y Altidore protagonizan World Golf Cup in the Canary Islands, donde mezclan golf, recuerdos mundialistas, rivalidad y confesiones personales en plena cuenta atrás para el Mundial 2026.

programme.title: El último duelo
programme.desc: El Mundial de 2026 podría ser el último en el que coincidan Cristiano Ronaldo y Lionel Messi. Con este telón de fondo, este documental realiza un viaje al origen de la rivalidad que protagonizó el fútbol moderno y convirtió LaLiga en un fenómeno global.

programme.title: LALIGA EA SPORTS: Rayo - Alavés
programme.desc: Los mejores clubes del país protagonizan LaLiga, el campeonato de la regularidad del fútbol español. El torneo es una carrera de fondo en la que los equipos pelean por sus metas: la salvación, Europa, la Champions o el título. El Barcelona defiende corona.

programme.title: Revelado - Lopetegui
programme.desc: Julen Lopetegui se sincera en Revelado, un espacio de DAZN en el que conocemos el lado más personal de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Revelado - Roberto Martínez
programme.desc: Roberto Martínez se sincera en Revelado, un espacio de DAZN en el que conocemos el lado más personal de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Revelado - Luis de la Fuente
programme.desc: Luis de la Fuente entró sin hacer ruido en el banquillo de la Selección, pero ha conseguido impregnar un sello propio al equipo nacional de España. Con él se han logrado Liga de Naciones y Eurocopa y ahora afronta el reto más complicado: el Mundial.

programme.title: Revelado - Rodri
programme.desc: Rodrigo Hernández se sincera en Revelado, un espacio de DAZN en el que conocemos el lado más personal de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Sport 50
programme.desc: Nicolas et Julia, deux athlètes engagés, ont parcouru près de 1000 kilomètres entre Paris et Chamonix, à raison de 50 kilomètres par jour pendant 20 jours. Leur objectif : aller à la rencontre de clubs sportifs, d'associations, d'élus locaux et d'experts afin de comprendre concrètement comment le changement climatique impacte la pratique du sport et comment les acteurs du secteur s'adaptent au quotidien.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Match Game
programme.desc: Gene Rayburn hosts this comedy-game show hybrid in which contestants try to match answers given by celebrities to humorous, and often risque, fill-in-the-blank questions. The contestant with the most points at the end of the game advances to play the bonus round, in which the contestant has a chance to win thousands of dollars, with the actual amount dependent on the rules in place at the time of the episode.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: This newsmagazine investigates intriguing crime and justice cases that touch on all aspects of the human experience. Over its long run, the show has helped exonerate wrongly convicted people, driven the reopening -- and resolution -- of cold cases, and changed numerous lives. CBS News correspondents offer an in-depth look into each story, with the emphasis on solving the mystery at its heart. The program and its team have earned critical acclaim, including 20 Emmys and three Peabody Awards.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.

programme.desc: Fierce rivals do battle as Canada hosts the United States in a 4 Nations Face-Off showdown. Canada won its opener over Sweden in dramatic fashion on Mitch Marner's goal at 6:06 of overtime. The Tkachuk brothers powered the U.S. past Finland, 6-1.

programme.title: 2025 4 Nations Face-Off
programme.desc: The United States squares off with Sweden in the last 4 Nations Face-Off round-robin match. The U.S. clinched its berth in the final by defeating Finland and Canada by a combined 9-2 score, while Sweden was defeated by both 4-3 in overtime.

programme.title: 2025 4 Nations Face-Off
programme.desc: Canada and the U.S. meet in the inaugural 4 Nations Face-Off championship game. Jake Guentzel scored twice as the U.S. clinched a spot in the final with a 3-1 win over Canada on Feb. 15. Canada held off Finland 5-3 on Feb. 17 to secure the rematch.

programme.title: Journey: A Voice Lost... and Found
programme.desc: Journey dominated the American music scene in the seventies and eighties with their epic arena rock anthems and power ballads. Frontman Steve Perry was dubbed The Voice thanks to the untouchable vocal stylings that burned up the radio waves and made him a household name. But the bigger Journey got, the more miserable Perry grew. He was the rare rock superstar who craved anonymity more than applause. Then at the height of the band's success, Perry did the completely unthinkable-he quit Journey. That should've been an absolute death knell for a band so defined by a single voice. But Journey's other longtime members refused to give up the dream and brought in a new singer to keep the music going. Fans were livid that anyone would dare to try to fill Steve Perry's shoes-shows were played in empty houses and threats were even made against the band.

programme.desc: New York land baron Alfredo Martino (Eduardo Ciannelli) has started burning down his own buildings and cashing in on the insurance, but he needs a fall guy. He finds the perfect target in Gabe Ryan (Frankie Thomas), a nice kid with a troubled past and a bad habit of being in the wrong place at the wrong time. Gabe's big sister, Joy (Ann Sheridan), then teams up with her brother's ragtag juvenile hall pals (The Dead End Kids) and lawyer, Pat Remson (Ronald Reagan), to clear the boy's name.

programme.title: Down in San Diego
programme.desc: A guy (Ray McDonald) and his girlfriend (Bonita Granville) thwart a wartime spy ring at a California Navy base.

programme.title: Seven Miles From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Alcatraz inmates Champ and Jimbo, who were gangsters on the outside, learn about the attack on Pearl Harbor and get the idea that the island prison they call home is sure to be the next attack site. They break out of jail and make it to a tiny lighthouse isle, where they take the few inhabitants hostage. But when Champ and Jimbo uncover a Nazi plot to take over the lighthouse, the crooks must choose to either flee or stay put and stick up for their country.

programme.title: Hitler's Children
programme.desc: Anna Muller (Bonita Granville), a U.S. citizen studying at the American Colony School in Germany, befriends both a teacher, "Nicky" Nichols (Kent Smith), and Karl Bruner (Tim Holt), a student at a neighboring school who joins the Hitler Youth. Years after they graduate, Karl returns as a Nazi officer and sends Anna -- now a teacher herself -- to a labor camp. While Karl praises the changes in Anna, Nicky works in secret to help her escape from the Nazis.

programme.title: Youth Runs Wild
programme.desc: The teens of a defense-plant town hop on the road to juvenile delinquency while their parents are busy with the war.

programme.title: The Truth About Murder
programme.desc: A district attorney (Morgan Conway) opposes his lawyer girlfriend (Bonita Granville) on a case until a polygraph ends it.

programme.title: These Three
programme.desc: Martha (Miriam Hopkins) and Karen (Merle Oberon) graduate from college and turn an old Massachusetts farm into a school for girls. The friends are aided in their venture by local doctor Joe Cardin (Joel McCrea), who begins a relationship with Karen, and a prominent woman whose granddaughter, Mary (Bonita Granville), later enrolls in the new school. Mary soon reveals herself to be a spiteful child and tells a scandalous lie about Martha and Joe that threatens to destroy the lives of all involved.

programme.title: Beloved Brat
programme.desc: Roberta (Bonita Granville) is raised in a wealthy home, and she is ignored by her busy parents. As her behavior worsens, she is placed in a boarding school for troubled girls, and she is given responsibilities to teach her manners.

programme.title: Nancy Drew, Detective
programme.desc: Teen sleuth Nancy Drew (Bonita Granville), always eager to solve a mystery, grows suspicious when eccentric dowager Mary Eldridge (Helena Phillips Evans) vanishes after promising a small fortune to Nancy's school. Though Miss Eldridge's accountant claims she's gone away for her health, Nancy senses foul play when a lost carrier pigeon delivers a cryptic clue. Despite the warnings of her dad (John Litel) and her pal Ted (Frankie Thomas), Nancy can't stop herself from investigating.

programme.title: Nancy Drew -- Reporter
programme.desc: Girl sleuth Nancy Drew (Bonita Granville) is always on the case when a mystery springs up in River Heights. This time, Nancy enters an amateur journalism contest and runs smack into a plot to frame an innocent young woman for murder. With the aid of her long-suffering chum, Ted (Frank Thomas Jr.), and some legal advice from her attorney dad (John Litel), Nancy nabs an elusive piece of evidence that she hopes will prove the identity of the real killer -- and win her the journalism prize to boot.

programme.title: Where the Crawdads Sing
programme.desc: When a man is found dead, a woman who lives by herself in the dangerous marshlands of North Carolina becomes the main suspect. As the case unfolds, the verdict as to what happened becomes increasingly unclear, threatening to reveal many secrets.
